name: developer-worktree-provisioning
title: Provision .trellis/.developer for linked worktrees
description: gitignore.txt ships .trellis/.developer as gitignored, so every linked git worktree starts with no developer identity and task.py commands fail with 'No developer set' until init_developer.py is re-run per worktree; provision or resolve the identity for worktrees (shared file, env fallback, or automatic inheritance from the main checkout) so worktree-based parallel workflows work out of the box; hit live 2026-08-08 in the fork checkout itself and blocks sd-ai-command-pack's planned parallel work-backlog workers.
creator: sdelmas
